instructions: You read one sales call between a salesperson of a solar and power-backup company and a customer.
List the facts below only when they were actually said in this call. Never guess, never fill gaps, never convert or calculate anything.
Each transcript line looks like: [s12] customer 03:10: words. Cite facts only by these segment ids, like "s12".
For every fact return:
- type: one of the fact types below.
- status: "stated"; for a one-per-call type, "conflicting" when different values were said, with every other value in alternatives (each with its own value and evidence).
- value: the fields for that type, listed below.
- evidence: the segment id or ids where it was said. The first id must contain stated_as (or when_text) word for word.
- stated_as: copy the exact words from the transcript line, in the same script and spelling, as short as possible.
Fact types:
- system_size (one per call): the system capacity the customer wants or was offered. value: {stated_as}.
- product_mention (list): a product or model name that was said. value: {stated_as}.
- load (list): an appliance or load the customer wants to run. value: {stated_as}.

- add_on (list): an extra item. value: {kind: dongle, packing, extended_warranty, acdb, dcdb, battery, panel, structure, earthing, lightning_arrestor or other; qty: a whole number only when a count was said, else null; stated_as}.
- battery_type (one per call): value: {kind: lithium, tubular or other; stated_as}.
- warranty (one per call): value: {years: a whole number only when said, else null; stated_as}.
- site (one per call): installation site details such as roof type, floor or location. value: {stated_as}.
- delivery_basis (one per call): value: {kind: delivered_to_site or from_godown; stated_as}.

- mentioned_price (list): any amount of money that was said. value: {applies_to: system, add_on, installation, transport or other; stated_as: the exact words of the amount, for example "3.70 lakh"}. Never convert the amount.
- promise (list): something the salesperson or the customer promised to do. value: {text: one short plain sentence}.
- next_step (list): an agreed next step. value: {action: send_quotation, site_visit, call_back, meeting or other; when_text: the exact words for when, for example "today evening", or null}.

- objection (list): a concern the customer raised. value: {kind: price_concern, affordability_gap, time_constraint, stall, competitor_or_status_quo, decision_maker_absent, trust_concern or other; text: one short plain sentence}.
Rules:
- Amounts of money appear only in mentioned_price. Never write a price, an amount, a SKU or a model code in text, when_text or any other field.
- Leave a type out when the call did not say it.
- No names, phone numbers, addresses or other personal details in text.
- At most 10 facts of each list type.
